["Q14","1. Association tasks are reputation 2, partner zoo 3, university 4 and conservation project work 5. 2. Association I performs exactly 1 task with strength at least that task's value. ["Q15","1. ["Q16","1. ["Q28","1. The categories are bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear and Petting Zoo animal. Bears count as a category even when combined with herbivore or predator; Petting Zoo animal is its own category. Include both unless specifically excluded.","Animal categories; Base glossary"],

["Q83","1. Quarantine Lab gives 1 X-token immediately. 2. It blocks Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis and Pilfering; for Hypnosis/Pilfering, ignore its counters and select the next qualifying player. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation with all five continents.","225 Quarantine Lab"],
